description:
Health summary of the user's saved stack on thedailyworkflow.com:
    how many of their tools are alive, protected, slow or dead, and which
    ones are dead. Needs the personal API key (see get_my_saved_tools).

    Use this when the user asks whether their tools are up, or wants a
    status report on their AI stack.

api_key.description: Personal API key of the TheDailyWorkflow account, generated at https://thedailyworkflow.com/my-workflow (section "Personal API key"). It is sent as a Bearer token and selects whose stack health is summarized.
api_key.title: Api Key

name: get_my_stack_health
